_comment: RATCHET BASELINE. Routes declared in the frozen v1.0.0 RouteClass taxonomy
that have no real codec. They fail closed by design (success=False), and
pruning them from the taxonomy would trip the WP-3 revision gate plus a
version bump, so they are retained deliberately (Vega ruling 2026-08-03).
THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. Building a codec removes its route from here.
Adding a route requires raising max_unbuilt_routes, which is a deliberate,
reviewable act — that is the whole point of the ratchet. The defect this
guards is not any single routing table entry: it is that a route could be
DECLARED WITHOUT BEING BUILT and nothing anywhere failed.
Recorded, NOT fixed, per Vega 2026-08-07. These rules select a primary
route that has no codec. They are SAFE because each one's fallback IS
built, so traffic degrades rather than dying — but the consequence is
that this content never reaches its intended codec. A NEW entry here
should be treated as a defect, not absorbed silently.

R_SUMMARY_CUES.note: summary-cue content never reaches a summarizer; falls back to prose compression

R_CONTENT_TYPE_SUMMARY.note: content_type=summary never reaches a summarizer; falls back to prose compression

R_TABLE_MARKDOWN.note: markdown tables never reach a table codec; degrade to no compression

R_OCR_HINT.note: OCR-hinted content never reaches an OCR codec; degrades to no compression

R_IMAGE_METADATA.note: image metadata never reaches an image codec; degrades to passthrough

R_BULLET_KEYPOINTS.note: bullet notes never reach a keypoint codec; degrade to no compression

R_CONTENT_TYPE_BULLETS.note: content_type=bullet_notes never reaches a keypoint codec; degrades to no compression. Found by this ratchet on its first run — it was missing from the hand-written baseline, which is the omission the guard exists to catch.
